Although the argument was not overwhelmingly persuasive (30/100), it touches on the concept of income stability. However, given my strong opposition to minimum wage increases due to concerns about inflation and small business survival (C_03 and C_06), the idea of a *subsidy* is a slightly less threatening concept than a blanket mandated wage increase.

I will slightly increase my awareness of this concept, but I will not fundamentally shift my core beliefs, as the argument was not highly persuasive.

I will add C_01 to my repertoire with a low strength to register that I heard it, but not strongly endorse or reject it.
